services.desc: Stop by Blue Star Arts Collective (Studio 209) in The Upstairs Studios for "Demolition and Reconstruction" - A FotoSeptiembre Exhibit. See full details below. This exhibit was created in response to the tragedy of untimely deaths and the effects of trauma and grief in survivors. I am mourning death as well as severed relationships as I confront the demolition site. Perhaps new patterns can emerge both internally and externally. Death has a way of revealing schisms that already existed. Ultimately, beyond all opinions and power structures, we will all die and return to the earth and the stones.
